title: Customer Segmentation with k-Means & kNN
blurb: Cluster customers with your own k-means, choose k scientifically, and add a kNN classifier.
brief: Take a customer or e-commerce dataset, clean and scale it, then implement k-means (with k-means++ initialization, convergence checks and inertia tracking) and a kNN classifier yourself. Pick k using the elbow method and silhouette score, label the segments in plain business language, and test how stable they are across random seeds.
requirements: Feature scaling and a documented cleaning step
k-means with centroid assignment, centroid update, tolerance and max iterations
k-means++ (or a clearly documented alternative) initialization
Inertia/elbow and silhouette score computed by you
A kNN classifier using an efficient top-k selection
A stability check across random seeds and a short business interpretation of each cluster
deliverables: A report with the elbow plot, silhouette scores and cluster profiles
Tests on small synthetic blobs with known clusters
resume_bullet: Built k-means (k-means++, silhouette analysis) and kNN from scratch to segment customers, validating cluster stability across seeds.
